board_examples.failure_selection_rule: lexicographically first pair where at least one full donor did not prefer its legal candidate
board_examples.selection_rule: lower median after sorting all primary pairs by channel_contrast, then pair_id

claim_boundaries: Cache swaps measure boundary-carried memory influence; both channel types remain active afterward.
Linear recoverability is accessibility evidence, not proof that the decoded features mediate behavior.
Crossed caches have no unique gold board and are reported against A, B, and neither.
Matched real-game contrasts are a diagnostic distribution, not all human chess.
Piece-and-rule state excludes repetition and complete draw-rule history.
